title: Media control keyboard shortcuts always work on lock screen even if display of media control buttons is disabled
line: When the lock screen is set not to show media controls, the media keys no longer play, pause or skip music while the screen is locked.
explanation: While the screen is locked, KWin hands key presses to kscreenlocker, which forwards a fixed whitelist of global shortcuts to kglobalaccel. The whitelist always included the mediacontrol component (play/pause, next, previous, stop), so media keys kept working no matter whether the lock screen's 'Show media controls' option was off. The change reads that option (kscreenlockerrc [Greeter][LnF][General] showMediaControls, default true) when the lock starts and leaves the mediacontrol shortcuts out when it is off.

commits.message:
globalaccel: don't allow media shortcuts when media controls are hidden

The media keys always reached the player while the screen was locked,
even when the lock screen was set not to show media controls. Now the
media control shortcuts are only allowed when that setting is enabled.

BUG: 461891

media.caption: Media controls hidden on the lock screen, yet Play/Next pressed while locked still paused, skipped and resumed the player.
Same setup with the fix: the keys still work unlocked, but while locked they no longer reach the player.

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in kscreenlocker's GlobalAccel::components() that reads kscreenlockerrc [Greeter][LnF][General] showMediaControls fresh via a local KConfig when locking and omits /component/mediacontrol from the lock-screen shortcut whitelist when disabled. This directly resolves the privacy issue where media keys could resume playback while media controls were hidden, while preserving volume, brightness, and other whitelisted shortcuts as well as unlocked media keys. Verification and before/after evidence match the change.
